verses.text: Praise the LORD, my soul. LORD my God, you are very great. You are dressed in honour and majesty.
He wraps himself in light like a robe. He stretches out the skies like a tent.
He sets the beams of his upstairs rooms on the waters above. He makes the clouds his chariot. He rides on the wings of the wind.
He makes the winds his messengers, and flames of fire his servants.
He set the earth on its foundations, so it can never be moved.
You covered it with the deep sea like a robe. The waters stood above the mountains.
But when you warned them, the waters ran away. At the sound of your thunder they hurried off.
The mountains rose up, and the valleys sank down to the places you had set for them.
You set a border the waters cannot cross, so they will never again cover the earth.
He makes springs pour water into the valleys. It flows between the mountains.
The springs give water to all the wild animals. The wild donkeys satisfy their thirst.
The birds of the sky build nests beside the waters. They sing among the branches.
He waters the mountains from his rooms above. The earth is filled with the good things you make.
He makes grass grow for the cattle, and plants for people to grow, so they can get food from the earth:
wine that makes people's hearts glad, oil that makes their faces shine, and bread that gives them strength.
The LORD's trees get plenty of water, the cedars of Lebanon that he planted.
Birds build their nests there. The stork makes its home in the pine trees.
The high mountains belong to the wild goats. The rocks are a place of safety for the rock badgers.
He made the moon to mark the seasons. The sun knows when to go down.
You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the animals of the forest come out to hunt.
The young lions roar for their prey. They look to God for their food.
When the sun rises, they slip away and lie down in their dens.
Then people go out to their work and labour until evening.
LORD, how many things you have made! You made them all with wisdom. The earth is full of your creatures.
There is the sea, huge and wide, full of more creatures than anyone can count, living things both large and small.
There the ships sail, and there is Leviathan, which you made to play in the sea.
All of them look to you to give them their food at the right time.
When you give it to them, they gather it up. When you open your hand, they are filled with good things.
When you hide your face, they are terrified. When you take away their breath, they die and go back to the dust.
When you send your Spirit, they are created, and you make the face of the earth new.
May the glory of the LORD last forever. May the LORD be glad about what he has made.
He looks at the earth, and it shakes. He touches the mountains, and they smoke.
I will sing to the LORD all my life. I will sing praise to my God as long as I live.
May my thoughts please him. I will be glad in the LORD.
Let sinners disappear from the earth. Let the wicked be gone forever. Praise the LORD, my soul. Praise the LORD!
